# Sky for reflections

`sky.hdr` is "Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)" by Greg Zaal, from Poly Haven (CC0), at 1k.
The sim uses it as the reflected sky for outdoor materials (metal, glass, wet ground), dimmed at night.
Swap in any 1k–2k equirectangular `.hdr` with the same name to change it.
